items.title: The Dataflow Model Revisited
items.blurb: Abstract Eleven years ago, the Dataflow Model paper argued that unbounded, out-of-order data was the new normal, and that we must stop waiting for data to ever become complete.

items.title: Article: Implementing Chaos Engineering in Financial Payment Systems: Lessons from Enterprise ECS Deployments
items.blurb: Standard chaos engineering assumes experiments stop cleanly, blast radius is knowable in advance, and production is fair game. Payment systems violate all three.
